title: The Birth of Jesus Christ
status: draft: written 19 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 1 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child retells the birth of Jesus (Luke 2:4-13): Bethlehem, no room, manger, angels and shepherds.

floor.prerequisite: Knows Christmas is about Jesus' birth.
floor.question: Whose birth do we celebrate at Christmas?

board.do: Draw a manger with a baby.
Wait for the child to say baby Jesus.

misconceptions.ask: Where was baby Jesus laid after he was born?
misconceptions.repair: Show a manger: a feeding box for animals.

misconceptions.ask: In which town was Jesus born?
misconceptions.repair: Draw the journey from Nazareth to Bethlehem.

misconceptions.ask: Who told the shepherds about baby Jesus?
misconceptions.repair: Show an angel appearing to shepherds at night.

misconceptions.ask: Was there room for Mary and Joseph in the inn?
misconceptions.repair: Read Luke 2:7 and act knocking at a full inn.
